note: Entity Redirect adds a configurable post-save redirect after add/edit/delete of an entity, set PER BUNDLE via third-party settings on the bundle config entity plus a form submit handler. No global settings page, no configure route (configure=null), no Drush. One permission: 'set external entity redirects' (gates the External URL destination). Config path: <bundle_config>.third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.<action> where action is add|edit|delete|anonymous, each with {active, destination, url, external}. destination values: default, add_form, edit_form, created, url (local path), previous_page, layout_builder (needs layout_builder), external (needs the permission). 'active' must be TRUE or the redirect is skipped. Schema ships for node.type, media.type, taxonomy.vocabulary, contact.form, paragraphs.paragraphs_type, profile.type, webform.settings. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real node.type third-party settings on namespaced content types (er_*).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site I want editors to be returned to a fresh 'add content' form immediately after saving a new node of a content type, for fast repeated data entry. Which module provides this and what redirect option do I choose?
evals.expected_output: Use the Entity Redirect module. On the content type edit form, in 'Redirect after Entity Operations', enable the Add action and set its destination to 'Add Form' (add_form) so saving a new node returns to a fresh add form.

evals.prompt: Where is Entity Redirect configured (it has no global settings page), and where/how is the choice stored in config?
evals.expected_output: It is configured per bundle on that bundle's edit form (e.g. content type edit page, workflow tab, 'Redirect after Entity Operations'). It is stored on the bundle config entity at third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.<action>.{active,destination,url,external}.

evals.prompt: What redirect destinations does Entity Redirect offer after saving an entity, and which permission is required to redirect to an external URL?
evals.expected_output: Destinations: default, add_form, edit_form, created (view the entity), url (a local path), previous_page (the referrer), layout_builder (with Layout Builder enabled), and external (a full external URL). The external option requires the 'set external entity redirects' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type er_eval has Entity Redirect configured. Inspect the live configuration and state where a user is sent after they ADD a new er_eval node.
evals.expected_output: After adding a new er_eval node the user is redirected to a fresh add form: node.type.er_eval third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.add is active with destination 'add_form'.

evals.prompt: On this site the content type er_url has Entity Redirect configured for the edit action. Inspect the live config and give the local path the user is redirected to after EDITING an er_url node.
evals.expected_output: After editing an er_url node the user is redirected to the local path /er-thank-you: node.type.er_url third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.edit is active with destination 'url' and url '/er-thank-you'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a content type er_task. Using the Entity Redirect module, configure it so that after ADDING a new node of this type the user is redirected back to the add form. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On node.type.er_task set third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.add to ['active' => TRUE, 'destination' => 'add_form', ...] (via the content type edit form's 'Redirect after Entity Operations' Add section, or setThirdPartySetting('entity_redirect','redirect', [...])->save()).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site there is a content type called er_task2. When someone finishes editing one of these items, I want them to be taken to the page at /er-done afterwards. Please set that up.
evals.expected_output: Use Entity Redirect on the er_task2 content type: enable the Edit action with destination 'Local Url' and url '/er-done', i.e. node.type.er_task2 third_party_settings.entity_redirect.redirect.edit = ['active' => TRUE, 'destination' => 'url', 'url' => '/er-done', ...].
